datasets.name: ds_phase_summary
queryLines:
WITH r AS (
  SELECT
    platform,
    test_type,
    scale,
    warehouse_size,
    warehouse_size_type,
    optimization_strategy,
    strategy_slug,
    CASE
      WHEN platform = 'databricks' THEN concat('DBX/', lower(strategy_slug))
      ELSE concat('SF/', lower(strategy_slug))
    END AS combined_label,
    COUNT(*) AS query_count,
    SUM(duration_ms) AS sum_duration_ms,
    AVG(CAST(duration_ms AS DOUBLE)) AS avg_duration_ms,
    MAX(CAST(duration_ms AS BIGINT)) AS max_duration_ms,
    CAST(
      (unix_timestamp(MAX(end_time)) - unix_timestamp(MIN(start_time))) AS DOUBLE
    ) AS wall_clock_seconds
  FROM
    tpcds_sf_catalog.tpcds.results_queries
  GROUP BY
    1,
    2,
    3,
    4,
    5,
    6,
    7,
    8
)
SELECT
  r.platform,
  r.test_type,
  r.scale,
  r.warehouse_size,
  r.warehouse_size_type,
  r.optimization_strategy,
  r.strategy_slug,
  r.combined_label,
  concat(r.test_type, ' / ', r.combined_label) AS phase_strategy,
  CASE r.test_type
    WHEN 'ingestion' THEN 1
    WHEN 'power' THEN 2
    WHEN 'concurrency' THEN 3
    ELSE 99
  END AS phase_order,
  COALESCE(p.tier, '(unpriced)') AS tier,
  r.query_count,
  r.sum_duration_ms,
  r.avg_duration_ms,
  r.max_duration_ms,
  r.wall_clock_seconds,
  ROUND(
    r.sum_duration_ms / 3600000.0 * COALESCE(p.units_per_hour, 0) * COALESCE(p.price_per_unit, 0),
    4
  ) AS cost_usd_summed,
  ROUND(
    r.wall_clock_seconds / 3600.0 * COALESCE(p.units_per_hour, 0) * COALESCE(p.price_per_unit, 0),
    4
  ) AS cost_usd_wallclock,
  COALESCE(p.unit_label, 'unit') AS unit_label
FROM
  r
    LEFT JOIN tpcds_sf_catalog.tpcds.results_prices p
      ON p.platform = r.platform
      AND p.warehouse_size = r.warehouse_size
      AND p.warehouse_size_type = r.warehouse_size_type
      AND p.region = 'us-east-1'
      AND p.tier
        = (
          CASE
            WHEN r.platform = 'databricks' THEN :dbx_tier
            ELSE :sf_tier
          END

datasets.name: ds_sf_tiers
queryLines:
SELECT DISTINCT
  tier
FROM
  tpcds_sf_catalog.tpcds.results_prices
WHERE
  platform = 'snowflake'
  AND tier IS NOT NULL
  AND COALESCE(:sf_tier, '') = COALESCE(:sf_tier, '')
ORDER BY
  tier

queryLines:
